## High-Protein Week-Long Meal Prep Plan

A budget-friendly prep plan built around **chicken, eggs, tofu, rice, and oats**, targeting about **140 g protein/day** with lactose-free meals and simple repeatable portions.

## 7-Day Meal Structure and Macros

| Meal | What you eat | Approx. calories | Approx. protein |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Breakfast | Protein oats with eggs on the side | 450 | 35 g |
| Lunch | Chicken rice bowl with vegetables | 550 | 45 g |
| Snack | Egg muffins or hard-boiled eggs + fruit | 250 | 18 g |
| Dinner | Tofu rice stir-fry or chicken bowl | 550 | 42 g |
| Daily total |  | **1,800** | **140 g** |

### Daily Menu Rotation
- **Mon/Wed/Fri/Sun**
  - Breakfast: Protein oats + 3 eggs
  - Lunch: Chicken rice bowl
  - Snack: 2 egg muffins
  - Dinner: Tofu stir-fry with rice

- **Tue/Thu/Sat**
  - Breakfast: Protein oats + 3 eggs
  - Lunch: Chicken rice bowl
  - Snack: 2 hard-boiled eggs + apple
  - Dinner: Chicken rice bowl or tofu rice bowl

## Meal Prep Menu Details

### Breakfast: Protein Oats + Eggs
- **Ingredients per serving:** oats, water or unsweetened soy milk, chia seeds, peanut butter, cinnamon, 3 eggs
- **Approx. macros:** **450 calories, 35 g protein**
- **Prep note:** cook oats in bulk; add eggs fresh or boil ahead

### Lunch: Chicken Rice Bowl
- **Ingredients per serving:** chicken breast, rice, broccoli, carrots, soy sauce, garlic, olive oil
- **Approx. macros:** **550 calories, 45 g protein**
- **Prep note:** portion into 7 containers for grab-and-go lunches

### Snack: Egg Muffins or Hard-Boiled Eggs
- **Ingredients per serving:** eggs, spinach, bell pepper, salt, fruit
- **Approx. macros:** **250 calories, 18 g protein**
- **Prep note:** use muffins for 3–4 days; hard-boil the rest for later in the week

### Dinner: Tofu Rice Stir-Fry
- **Ingredients per serving:** extra-firm tofu, rice, mixed vegetables, soy sauce, sesame oil
- **Approx. macros:** **550 calories, 42 g protein**
- **Prep note:** press tofu before cooking for better texture and higher flavor absorption

## Sunday Prep Schedule

### 1) Start the grains and proteins
- Cook a large batch of rice for the week
- Bake or pan-cook chicken breast
- Press and cube tofu

### 2) Prep breakfast and snacks
- Make overnight oats or dry oat packs for 7 breakfasts
- Hard-boil eggs
- Bake egg muffins with spinach and peppers

### 3) Cook vegetables and assemble
- Roast or steam broccoli, carrots, and mixed vegetables
- Portion lunches and dinners into containers
- Label containers by day

### 4) Store for the week
- Keep 3–4 days in the fridge
- Freeze 2–3 portions of chicken or tofu if needed
- Refrigerate sauces separately to keep meals fresh

## Consolidated Ingredient List

### Protein
- Chicken breast: **4.5–5 lb**
- Extra-firm tofu: **4 blocks**
- Eggs: **3 dozen**

### Carbs and breakfast items
- Rolled oats: **1 large container**
- Rice: **5–6 cups dry**
- Fruit: **7 apples or bananas**

### Vegetables
- Broccoli: **3 heads or 3 large bags frozen**
- Carrots: **2 lb**
- Bell peppers: **4**
- Spinach: **1 large box**
- Mixed stir-fry vegetables: **2–3 bags**

### Fats, sauces, and flavor
- Peanut butter
- Chia seeds
- Olive oil
- Sesame oil
- Soy sauce or tamari
- Garlic
- Cinnamon
- Salt and pepper

## Budget Check

- Chicken: **$20–28**
- Tofu: **$8–12**
- Eggs: **$8–12**
- Rice and oats: **$8–10**
- Vegetables and fruit: **$20–25**
- Sauces and pantry items: **$8–12**

Estimated total: **$72–$89**

## Quick Actions
- Action: [Button: Print Plan] https://www.google.com/search?q=high+protein+meal+prep+plan+shopping+list
- Action: [Button: Swap Recipes] https://www.google.com/search?q=lactose+free+high+protein+meal+prep+recipes

## Sources
- USDA FoodData Central: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/
- MyFitnessPal food database: https://www.myfitnesspal.com/food/search
- Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics: https://www.eatright.org/
